meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 运行该技能，Claude 会把 DeltaChat 通道装进项目：复制适配器和注册测试、追加注册导入、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 并构建测试；再要求配置 .env 邮箱与 IMAP/SMTP。完成后邮件消息即可端到端加密收发。
howto.when: 当你想让机器人通过 DeltaChat 用邮件收发加密消息，要求接入或配置该通道，或在 /setup 流程中需要处理 DeltaChat 时触发。

say.text: 帮我给项目接入 DeltaChat，用邮件收发聊天。
say.note: 据此执行安装适配器的步骤。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 需要的邮箱和 IMAP/SMTP 信息。
say.note: 这些会写入 .env，服务启动时读取。

say.text: 生成 DeltaChat 邀请链接和二维码给我。
say.note: 启动服务后即可从日志或 SVG 文件获取。

howto.what_en: Running this skill adds the DeltaChat channel: copies adapter and registration test, appends the channel import, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, builds and validates. .env needs email and IMAP/SMTP credentials. End-to-end encrypted email messaging is then available.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask the bot to chat via DeltaChat over encrypted email, to add/configure this channel, or while handling DeltaChat inside the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Set up DeltaChat for my project so I can chat over email.
say_en.note: It will start adding the adapter.

say_en.text: Configure the DeltaChat mailbox and IMAP/SMTP credentials in .env.
Show me the DeltaChat invite link and QR code.
say_en.note: They are produced once the service is running.
